newsitem.title: USA: Clinton declares Pennsylvania, Oregon disaster areas.
newsitem.headline: Clinton declares Pennsylvania, Oregon disaster areas.

text.p: President Clinton declared Monday that Pennsylvania and Oregon had been stricken by major disasters, making victims of damaging rains and flooding in both states eligible for federal financial assistance.

Pennsylvania's Tioga County was struck by severe thunderstorms, high winds, rain and flooding between Nov. 8 and 15, while three counties in Oregon -- Coos, Douglas and Lane -- were hit by flooding and mudslides after heavy rain Nov. 17.
